reviews.title: App interface not working
reviews.text:
This is now the second review I have had to leave because I have received absolutely no response from the development team.

I have sent three separate emails regarding this issue and have yet to receive a single response. The app’s interface remains completely unresponsive, which means I am unable to use the app or even cancel my subscription through the app as I should be able to.

At this point, I am extremely frustrated that I have had to resort to leaving a public review simply to get someone’s attention. I paid for a subscription to a service that I can no longer use, and I should not have to repeatedly contact support with no response.

Please cancel my subscription immediately. I do not want to be redirected to the app or the App Store, as I have already been unable to resolve this issue through those channels. I am asking the development/support team to handle the cancellation directly and confirm that it has been completed.

The lack of communication and customer support throughout this entire situation has been extremely disappointing.
